text:
oncall-bot: PAGER ALERT > inference-prod us-west-2: sustained 5xx spike (gateway/timeouts) for model-runtime group A. Paging oncall (priority: high).

devon.sre: seeing 502/504s from gateway, error logs show repeated 'segfault' from model-runner on a subset of hosts.

cheng.runtime: confirmed - tail of /var/log/model-runner shows SIGSEGV at kv_cache.c:314, repeated during long context requests. Sample stack below:
```
#0  0x7f8a12c in kv_cache_get+0x2d
#1  0x4b5f90 in attention_forward
#2  0x4c1a20 in run_inference_loop
```

amanda-oncall: @cheng.runtime can we identify which host ids are failing? need to triage impact and callouts.

devon.sre: failing hosts: infer-uw2-12, infer-uw2-13, infer-uw2-18. Crash rate per-host ~8/min, but overall traffic routing still sending ~30% to that pool.

cheng.runtime: root cause seems memory corruption in the new quantized attention path; reproduces with long seqs (>2048). I can patch and build a hotfix but will take ~20-30m.

karthik-platform: immediate mitigation options: 1) evict affected hosts from load balancer, 2) route traffic to fallback model-variant (non-quantized), 3) increase retry/backoff at gateway. Suggest 1+2 for fastest customer relief.

sam-cs: customer impact - a handful of enterprise customers on dedicated pools reported increased 5xx and timeouts. CS ticket #4521 opened. We need ETA for customer comms.

amanda-oncall: I'll start steps: (A) drain+cordon infer-uw2-12/13/18, (B) flip routing for model-A to model-A-safe (no-quant) in us-west-2. @devon.sre please run the drain commands and post status.

devon.sre: running: `kubectl cordon infer-uw2-12 && kubectl drain infer-uw2-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then same for others. Drains started.

oncall-bot: deploy bot: Routing change request accepted; model-A -> model-A-safe rollout started (10% -> 100% over 5m).

devon.sre: drains completed for 12/13, 18. Traffic to affected hosts now ~0%. Gateway 5xx rate dropping from 6.2% -> 1.1% in last 2m.

cheng.runtime: starting a quick build of a patched runtime with bounds check in kv_cache. Will run canary on a single host once CI passes. If stable, we can roll forward.

karthik-platform: also temporarily enabling autoscaler emergency headroom in us-west-2 (+2 extra workers) to absorb replay traffic.

sam-cs: I pushed a short customer note to affected accounts: "We detected elevated 5xx and applied routing mitigation; we're monitoring and will follow up." Customers acknowledged.

amanda-oncall: status check in 10m. If patch stable, we'll plan controlled rollout and then bring drained hosts back. Otherwise we'll keep model-A on safe variant until patch is in.

cheng.runtime: CI passed. canary patch deployed to infer-uw2-21 (non-critical host). Running long-seq synthetic load now.

devon.sre: monitoring: canary stable for 12m under 2k concurrent tokens, no segfaults. Gateway 5xx now at 0.5%.

amanda-oncall: excellent. Plan: 1) ramp patched runtime to 20% over 5m, 2) monitor 5xx and oom metrics, 3) if green, full rollout and revert routing to model-A. Karthik will coordinate autoscaler rollback.

karthik-platform: acknowledged. Scheduling ramp.

sam-cs: updating tickets and adding timeline; will coordinate follow-up comms if any customers see residual errors.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation successful -> 5xx decreased to baseline. Patch rollout in progress. Postmortem owner: @cheng.runtime.

amanda-oncall: handing off to post-incident review. I'll close the pager after 30m of stable telemetry. Thanks all :tada:
